text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA Finale comes to a close to widespread acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Majestic! Incredible! Congratulations! To think your Umamusume would be the one to take the crown!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! It was worth all the trouble of holding the event just to see the satisfaction on your face!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: But you're far from the only one looking satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: All of the Umamusume in the crowd had their eyes glued to the race.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And all the other trainers are eager to seize this new honor!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: There is more excitement than I could ever have imagined! People are already looking forward to the next event!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And it's all thanks to you and the star Umamusume you raised!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I have no regrets. From the bottom of my heart, you have… my thanks!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Please keep doing your best to help Umamusume shine, in the future and beyond!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now, I do believe I've spoken for long enough! Go and see your partner!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I don't doubt that she's waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I meet up with <chrname> and leave the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, our conversation gradually grows more and more jovial as we reminisce about our journey to the top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We promise one another that no matter what new stages or rivals lie ahead, we'll do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Coming in! Please excuse the interruption at work, Trainer <username>!
choice_data_list: You almost gave me a heart attack…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Surprised, were you? Splendid! Just the response I was hoping for!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, off we go!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! That's the surprise! Now, come along, come along…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Got you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa suddenly pulls a sack over my head! I can't see a thing!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: This way! Never fear, I'll guide you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa takes me by the hand and leads me away as I ponder what fate is about to befall me…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And here we are!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: One… two… three!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Congratulations once again to the Finale Champion!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: To celebrate your accomplishment, I have taken the liberty of preparing a modest dinner!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Behold! My specialty, which I have dubbed… the Carrot Hamburger Steak DX! Eat as much as your heart desires!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The director has been working hard all day to get this ready.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Incorrect! If you take ingredient selection into account, I have been working on this for two months!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: …Such dedication.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Trainer <username>! Your trainee ran an amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: But that's the last time you'll get the better of us. Isn't that right, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Right. We'll always be… your rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the celebration continues, we reminisce about our shared experience and congratulate each other on a race well run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the celebration continues, we reminisce about our shared experience and congratulate each other on a race well run.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Delicious! My heart and stomach are both full!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hm… I may have been a little too enthusiastic with the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: But then again, a growing Umamusume needs to eat! Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now, then! There's something I've been wanting to give you for a while.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Please accept this fan!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: This fan was given to me by the former director. It's a symbol of my resolve, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However! As of today, I entrust it to you, along with the future of Umamusume everywhere!
choice_data_list: Are you sure I deserve an honor like this?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indubitably! Indeed, I can think of no one more suitable!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Vindication! The sparkle in your eyes, the set of your jaw! I knew I chose the right person!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>, I implore you: please continue to support the Umamusume of this academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I place the fan carefully in my pocket and vow alongside <chrname> that I won't betray Director Akikawa's passion!
